item.title: Lawsuit Targets California DMV Over Administrative Failures Affecting 20,000 CDL Drivers
item.description: A class-action lawsuit filed in Alameda County seeks to block California's Jan. 5 cancellation of nearly 20,000 commercial driver's licenses. The plaintiffs argue the DMV is punishing immigrant drivers for the agency's own administrative failures while refusing to let them reapply for corrected credentials, violating state law and due process.
